## How the guide defines it

## How the guide uses it

On 67 pages. The guide reaches for a base rate whenever one is available: Makinen's own four-year record of 57-42-2, the observation that a long-shot Heisman winner has hit two years running, Troy Calhoun never having had three consecutive losing seasons, the fact that the preseason Heisman favourite has not won since 2014, and Makinen's ATS angle for teams returning 17 or more starters over the first four weeks.

## Working definition — TTW DERIVED

An argument from a historical frequency — how often a situation has produced an outcome before — used to price a current one.

## Why it matters — TTW DERIVED

It is how the guide converts a story into something with a number attached, and it is the closest the book comes to a systematic method outside the power ratings.

## How bettors use it in this guide

As supporting evidence rather than as a standalone system, with one exception: the returning-starters ATS angle is stated as a rule with a window attached.
